scope: Register discard-only owners for trap parser state, PIPESTATUS and BASH_TRAPSIG snapshots, including the outer pending-signal dispatcher. Track active handler borrows and invalidate them at every actual string release; restart releases live borrows, detaching a still-inherited slot first. Normal returns retain GNU restoration and unlink ownership records. A pending trap returning out of a function disposes its otherwise abandoned status copy without restoring it.
archive_note: Paths relocated unchanged before adding normal-return unwinding; original compile command retained. Driver snapshot evidence/raw/bash-trap-restart-attached-driver.py.
